files.name: Monthly_codified_fake_data.csv
files.row_meaning: One patient, calendar month/year, and codified feature count.

columns.name: patient_num
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Same synthetic patient across the two demo files. 患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Generated full decimal IDs from -9900000200 to -9900000001. Read from CSV as character, then convert using bit64::as.integer64. No source IDs reused.

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: Calendar month of the feature occurrences. 发生月份。

columns.name: year
columns.meaning: Calendar year of the feature occurrences. 发生年份。
columns.demo_rule: Character year 2004–2023. Illustrative demo period, not established source coverage.

columns.name: feature_id
columns.meaning: Grouped codified feature identifier. 分组后的codified代码。
columns.demo_rule: Generated PheCode, CCS-PCS, CPT4 and LOCAL|PX format examples. Clinical meaning and validity not asserted.

columns.name: Group_Code_Count
columns.meaning: Number of occurrences of this feature for this patient in this calendar month. 该患者该月该特征的出现次数。
columns.demo_rule: Positive integer 1–20. 75% of draws use 1–3. Demonstration rule, not a measured distribution.

files.name: Monthly_NLP_fake_data.csv
files.row_meaning: One patient, calendar month/year, and NLP feature count.

columns.name: patient_num
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Same synthetic patient across the two demo files. 患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Generated numeric IDs from -9900000200 to -9900000001. No source IDs reused. Same logical IDs as the codified file.

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: Calendar month of the feature occurrences. 发生月份。

columns.name: year
columns.meaning: Calendar year of the feature occurrences. 发生年份。
columns.demo_rule: Integer year 2011–2021. Illustrative demo period, not established source coverage.

columns.name: feature_id
columns.meaning: NLP concept identifier, including CUI and AB-prefixed acronym concepts. NLP概念编号，可包含CUI和AB开头的缩写概念。
columns.demo_rule: Generated C-plus-seven-digit and AB-prefixed examples. Clinical meaning and validity not asserted.

columns.name: N
columns.meaning: Number of occurrences of this feature for this patient in this calendar month. 该患者该月该特征的出现次数。
columns.demo_rule: Positive integer 1–20. 75% of draws use 1–3. Demonstration rule, not a measured distribution.
